original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Prepared immutable geometry for PR589 full exact bit-word checking; differential corruption controls and identical-input performance measurements.
scope_change_reason: Initial one-A-write/no-A-donor cold-center screen had zero eligible helpers; pivot once from carried-helper interface research to scoped verification tooling. This does not meet bit-helper-contract construction admission.
bottleneck_link: Repeated gate/interface experiments on the selected bit supplier currently revalidate identical E8 geometry. Reusing only immutable validated geometry speeds exact candidate screening without changing suppliers, COPY pricing, admission or kappa; this is a tooling side result.
stop_rule: Check 16 specified exact oracle fixtures and four cache/source isolation controls; benchmark three specified words with three repeats per path, alternate order using assignment seed7; stop after one wrapper and bounded differential replay. No broader gauge search.
evidence: verify.py; EVIDENCE.json contains all full-oracle receipts/rejections and setup-inclusive benchmark. Checker tail executes full(), totals(), interface() on every candidate.
author: Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in source inspection, wrapper implementation, differential controls, benchmarking and documentation; Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337) is the contributor.

open_questions.question: Does the prepared path remain useful for a realistic stream of accepted and rejected gate mutations?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Measured speedups cover three selected-word variants; rejection timing depends on the failure stage and geometry reuse rate.
open_questions.first_step: Feed one pinned native bit-search candidate stream through the full and prepared paths; retain exact receipt equality and report fallback frequency and setup cost.
open_questions.blocked_by: A concrete reproducible search workload, rather than an invented aggregate benchmark.

candidate_tasks: Cold-A no-donor carried-helper entrance (screen empty; broader resynthesis open)
